data.body: VALIDATION_LIVE_EVIDENCE: PROGRESS 2026-05-25T22:30Z. Bug 5be7-d657-1dde-4237 FIXED via PR #352 (merged 22:24Z). Re-triggered dry-run: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26422283057. The 5be7 fix worked — guard sequence now passes Mode.from_str + check_pass_lock + check_phase_gate, proving the repo_root defaulting is correct. New defect surfaced: acquire_pass_lock fails because the CI checkout (fetch-depth=1) lacks the tickets branch locally and 'git worktree add tickets' returns exit 128. Filed P1 bug 96c5-03c6-338f-483f (child of this epic, same root-cause-class as 5be7: advisory_lock real-git path unexercised by the test suite). Live-evidence capture remains blocked until 96c5 lands. Same anti-pattern observation: the test suite fully stubs the advisory_lock module's interaction with real git, so production-only failures (None propagation, missing tickets branch in checkout) all pass CI green.
